svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Cairn Station: map
svg.desc: Plan of Cairn Station: 2 decks stacked on one sheet, from Surface at the top to Ice at the bottom. Each deck has a header with its department, every room carries its name, doors wear their department's colour, and stairs, ladders, a lift and cable risers are marked. The same rooms are listed below the picture.
svg.text: 2 decks stacked, the top deck first. 59 rooms. Floors and doors are coloured by the department that holds the key.

g.text: Command, science, medical, security, commons, food, cargo and engineering
The drill dock and shaft, core lab and store, cold vault and cellar, geothermal tap and fuel store

svg.text: Lift (a cart lift to every deck)
